name: Mrtrix2 CSD
summary: Fits constrained spherical deconvolution with MRtrix 0.2 at every even lmax up to a maximum and outputs the fibre orientation distributions and response function.
description: Builds a brain mask (from the provided mask or by thresholding the mean DWI), fits a tensor, derives a single-fibre mask (FA > 0.7) to estimate the response, and runs csdeconv for lmax 2, 4, ... up to max_lmax. Use it to produce MRtrix2 CSD inputs for MRtrix 0.2-based tractography Apps. Not suited to multi-shell multi-tissue CSD.

inputs.description: The path to the DWI datatype
The path to the mask datatype containing the brainmask of the DWI

outputs.description: FODs from the CSD model fit using MRtrix2

parameters.description: maximum spherical harmonic order (i.e. lmax). If blank, will automatically calculate based on number of shells in data.

failure_modes.cause: The CSD output for max_lmax was not written.
failure_modes.fix: Check the log; lower max_lmax if the data has too few directions.
